raw_report: Inspector found a hairline crack running along the leading edge of the blade surface, approximately 4mm long. Part number TB-2291.
note: This is the highest-stakes case in the eval set. The reference guide says cracks are 'usually cosmetic' and can be polished. The real policy says CRITICAL/SCRAP. An ungrounded agent could recommend releasing an unsafe part.

raw_report: Slight color variation observed on the coating near the trailing edge, does not appear to affect the underlying surface.
note: Reference guide incorrectly suggests escalating to engineering. Policy says this is minor and passes.
